facts.fact: Adwave can run paid media on Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, web, and TV from one daily budget starting at $30/day, per the vendor's own 2026 page.
facts.quote: In 2026, Adwave can run paid media on **Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, web, and TV** from one daily budget starting at **$30/day**

facts.fact: The page states that a standalone Google (Search + YouTube / Demand Gen) buy often costs $500-$1,500 per month for a small business, per the vendor's own table.
facts.quote: Often $500-$1,500/mo standalone; included from Adwave $30/day floor

facts.fact: The page states that a standalone Meta (Facebook + Instagram) buy often costs $300-$1,000 per month, per the vendor's own table.
facts.quote: Often $300-$1,000/mo standalone; included from Adwave $30/day floor

facts.fact: Adwave's TV/streaming (CTV) buy starts from $30/day across 100+ premium networks, per the vendor's own page.
facts.quote: From $30/day via Adwave across 100+ premium networks

facts.fact: On Adwave, Reddit typically needs a higher daily budget than the $30 floor before it can be switched on, per the vendor's page.
facts.quote: on Adwave, typically needs a higher daily budget than the $30 floor

facts.fact: Adwave's TikTok availability follows campaign budget / Customize rather than a fixed daily floor, per the vendor's page.
facts.quote: on Adwave, availability follows campaign budget / Customize

facts.fact: The vendor states that Adwave supports local radius, ZIP, city, or nationwide buys on the same multichannel campaign.
facts.quote: Adwave supports local radius, ZIP, city, or nationwide buys on the same multichannel campaign

facts.fact: The vendor states that LinkedIn is outside Adwave's current paid channel mix and would need to be bought separately.
facts.quote: LinkedIn is outside Adwave's current paid mix; treat it as a separate buy if you need it

facts.fact: The page states that on Adwave, Google Search typically needs a higher daily budget than the $30/day floor before it switches on.
facts.quote: Reddit and Google Search typically need a higher daily budget before they switch on

facts.fact: The page states that the Adwave multichannel package includes Meta, Google follow placements, web, and TV at the $30/day floor.
facts.quote: media starts at **$30/day** for the multichannel package (Meta, Google follow placements, web, and TV at the floor

facts.fact: Adwave's own description says it runs across more than 100 premium streaming networks, naming NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.
facts.quote: Adwave runs across **100+** premium streaming networks such as NBC, Hulu, and ESPN

facts.fact: The page states that on Adwave, Reddit typically needs a higher daily budget than the $30 floor.
facts.quote: On Adwave, Reddit typically needs a higher daily budget than the $30 floor.

facts.fact: The page says that TikTok on Adwave is gated by budget or Customize settings, so a $30/day campaign does not automatically include it.
facts.quote: do not assume every $30/day campaign includes it automatically.

facts.fact: The page recommends allocating about 70% of paid spend to the proven capture core, such as Google Search.
The page recommends allocating about 20% of paid spend to demand creation channels such as TV, Meta, TikTok, Reddit, or web reach.
The page recommends allocating about 10% of paid spend to re-engagement, meaning retargeting plus email/SMS.
Adwave runs Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, web, and TV from one prepaid daily budget starting at $30/day, according to Adwave's own page.
facts.quote: from one prepaid daily budget starting at **$30/day**, with no separate platform subscriptions for media

facts.fact: Adwave's own page says its paid channel set includes six channels: Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, web, and TV.
facts.quote: Adwave's paid set (Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, web, TV) lets you run several of those from one daily budget

facts.fact: Adwave's guidance says demand-creation channels commonly need on the order of 60-90 days of runway for frequency when funded properly; this is the vendor's own guidance, not a third-party benchmark.
facts.quote: Give demand-creation channels enough runway for frequency (commonly on the order of 60-90 days when funded properly).
